irreversible kinds.message: The action "a" declares kind "destroy" and reversible true. A destroy leaves nothing to write back, so it cannot be undone.
The action "b" declares kind "dispatch" and reversible true. A dispatch leaves nothing to write back, so it cannot be undone.
The action "c" declares kind "transfer" and reversible true. A transfer leaves nothing to write back, so it cannot be undone.

undeclared kind reads irreversible.message: The action "purgeOld" declares reversible true and names no kind, and its key reads as an act that cannot be undone. Add "kind" naming what it really does.
The action "SendMail" declares reversible true and names no kind, and its key reads as an act that cannot be undone. Add "kind" naming what it really does.
The action "archiveToEdepot" declares reversible true and names no kind, and its key reads as an act that cannot be undone. Add "kind" naming what it really does.

unknown kind.message: The action "x" names a kind the vocabulary does not hold. Use one of write, destroy, dispatch, transfer.
The action "y" names a kind the vocabulary does not hold. Use one of write, destroy, dispatch, transfer.

not a boolean.message: The action "x" must declare reversible as true or false.
The action "y" must declare reversible as true or false.

The action "v" names a reversalWindow but does not declare itself reversible, so the window bounds nothing.
